definition: PII is personal information that can identify an individual.
A managed data identifier is built-in detection logic for a specific sensitive data type.
A custom data identifier is detection logic built from a text pattern and optional context criteria.
A regular expression defines a pattern that text must match.
An allow list defines text or patterns that sensitive data analysis should ignore.
Sampling depth is the percentage of eligible objects selected for job analysis.
A delegated administrator is the account chosen to manage Macie for an organization.
Trusted service access allows an AWS service to integrate with Organizations on behalf of the organization.
A discovery result records an object analysis even when it finds no sensitive data or encounters an error.
